work.title: Keep non-accepted outcomes off the base
work.description: Update rollback, cancel, and supersede behavior to guarantee none of these outcomes creates or modifies a base projection.
acceptance: Rollback does not move the base
Cancel does not move the base
Supersede does not move the base
Candidate code is archived when candidate code exists
Branch and worktree cleanup remain idempotent
The terminal manifest remains available through the manifest ref
Late GitHub synchronization does not amend an integration commit
